summary:
Iteration 4 (both) — Slice 1 social layer end-to-end. Backend: 24/25 new tests pass (test_pairly_iter4_social.py). Verified: POST /api/posts photo + recipe with proper 400s (recipe missing title, photo with no image + no caption), GET/DELETE /posts with owner-only delete, GET /feed for_you + following (following scope correctly limited to followed users + self), like toggle keeps like_count consistent, comments + parent_id replies + author cards + comment_count decrement on delete + cross-user delete rejected, /collections auto-creates Favorites/Want To Cook/Meal Ideas, duplicate collection 400, bookmark toggle + cross-user collection listing 404, follow toggle with self=400/unknown=404, public profile hides email + returns is_following/is_self/counts/posts, followers + following lists, /me/liked, profile update taken=400/invalid chars=400 + bio/location/cuisine/avatar_b64 persist, /search returns {users,posts,pairings} shape and honours filters, /pairings items now carry flavor_profile+nutrition_notes+alternatives, recipe generator empty ingredients+goal=400 and full recipe returns {id, recipe:{title,ingredients,instructions,nutrition,shopping_list,drink_pairing,...}} — real LLM call took ~19s.

ONE BACKEND BUG FOUND: POST /api/recipes/generate calls ensure_quota() but used_today() (server.py:480) only counts pairings + menus + chat_messages — recipe generations do NOT increment used_today. Effect: a free user can generate unlimited recipes as long as their pairing+menu+chat count is <5. Spec says recipe generation should count toward the 5/day cap.

Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): login (had to click auth-tab-login first as default is signup), then all 5 bottom tabs Home/Search/Create/AI/Profile navigate correctly. Home = feed-scope-for_you/following toggle + notifications-button + post-card with like/comment/bookmark/share testIDs — one real post rendered (Marco, chef, 'Charred leeks with hazelnut', #leeks #vegetarian, 1 like, 1 comment). Search = search-input + type chips (all/recipes/posts/users/pairings) + search-filters-toggle + search-run-button. AI hub = ai-usage-pill ('5 free AI requests left today') + 5 tool cards (ai-pair, ai-recipe, ai-chat, ai-menus, saved-pairings). Profile = avatar + Home Cook + @homecook + bio ('TEST bio 1dd878') + location + fav cuisine + 4 stats + Edit profile + Posts/Collections/Liked tabs. Create = photo/recipe kind toggle, Add photo, caption, hashtags, Publish button.

Regression warning still present since iteration 2: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' from /app/frontend/app/pairing/[id].tsx off-screen share-card wrapper — the fix has now been outstanding for three iterations.

critical.issue: Recipe generation does not count toward used_today / daily free quota. server.py:480 used_today() only counts pairings + menus + chat_messages. Spec requires recipe generation to count toward the 5/day cap (402 when exhausted). Fix: extend used_today() to also count db.ai_recipes for the day.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning still emitted: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/pairing/[id].tsx — reported since iteration 2, still not fixed.

action_items: Fix quota bug in /app/backend/server.py used_today(): add db.ai_recipes count for today so /api/recipes/generate is counted toward the free 5/day cap (matches the iteration spec).
Cosmetic (carried since iter2): migrate off-screen wrapper in /app/frontend/app/pairing/[id].tsx from `pointerEvents='none'` prop to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` to silence RN Web deprecation.

Optional UX: add testID to the bottom Tabs.Screen items in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (e.g., tab-home/tab-search/tab-create/tab-ai/tab-profile) so future Playwright tests don't have to fall back to text matching.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1527 lines — well past the 700-line soft limit. Strongly recommend splitting into modules: auth, ai (llm+image+recipe), social (posts+comments+likes+follows+bookmarks+collections), search, chat, paypal. Maintainability risk grows with each iteration.

used_today() is the single quota source of truth but the list of tracked collections is hard-coded (pairings + menus + chat_messages). Adding /recipes/generate without updating it is exactly how the reported quota bug slipped in. Consider a central 'ai_events' collection or a decorator that stamps `ai_event: true` on all quota-consuming inserts.

toggle_bookmark falls back to Favorites when the requested collection_name doesn't match — this silently ignores the client's chosen collection instead of returning 400 for an unknown collection. Consider validating the collection name explicitly.
Frontend tab bar items lack testID props, so E2E tests fall back to fragile text selectors (Search, AI, Create can conflict with in-screen text).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (5-tab navigation, home feed rendering with post card and scope toggle, search screen shell, AI hub with 5 tools + usage pill, profile with stats and 3 tabs, create with photo/recipe kinds)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: TEST_recipegen_* free-tier user created for the LLM recipe test and torn down. Test posts/comments/bookmarks all cleaned up in fixture teardowns. chef@pairly.app and cook@pairly.app profiles were touched (cook's bio/location/favorite_cuisine/avatar set to TEST_* values — main agent may want to reset via PUT /api/profile if pristine state matters).
context_for_next_testing_agent: chef@pairly.app + cook@pairly.app exist; cook now has a base64 avatar + bio 'TEST bio ...' + location 'TEST city' + favorite_cuisine 'italian' from the profile-update test. Backend suite files: test_pairly_backend.py (auth/pairing base), test_pairly_new_features.py (image+chat+quota iter3), test_pairly_iter4_social.py (this iteration's social+collections+search+recipe+profile+pairing-extension). The one open bug is the recipe-generator quota — once main agent fixes used_today() to include ai_recipes, rerun TestRecipeGenerator::test_generate_recipe_ok and it should flip green. Auth flow gotcha: default auth tab is Signup, tests must click [data-testid='auth-tab-login'] BEFORE filling.
rca_of_issue: Quota bug RCA: /api/recipes/generate at server.py:1330 correctly calls ensure_quota(user) which gates on used_today() >= 5. However used_today() at server.py:480-488 aggregates counts only from db.pairings + db.menus + db.chat_messages — db.ai_recipes was never added when the recipe generator was introduced. Reproduction: signup fresh user → POST /api/recipes/generate with any valid ingredients → GET /api/usage → used_today stays at 0. Mitigation: extend used_today() with `db.ai_recipes.count_documents({'user_id': user_id, 'created_at': today})` (and consider centralising quota-consuming collections into a single list to prevent regressions on future AI endpoints).
